text:
Nina (AE): TideGate wants to run a POC focused on SSO/SCIM and RBAC mapping. Their security team listed blockers: EU-only data residency, BYOK, and verifiable domain controls across subsidiaries. Can SE/PS/sec take?
Omar (Solutions Eng): Yep. Quick clarifiers: do they need OIDC for SPA apps in addition to SAML for legacy? Also: SCIM scope = users + groups + custom attributes?
Jules (Pricing): If they expect predictable latency and 99.9% SLA we'll need committed capacity numbers. Rough monthly token estimates + peak qps will let me size Dedicated.
Priya (Security): From questionnaire: they want BYOK (customer KMS), audit log exports to their SIEM, and proof of SOC2/ISO. We can provide SOC2 report + BYOK integration doc. Also confirm whether logs require field-level redaction.
Nina (AE): They said primary IdP is Okta + a couple Azure tenants. OIDC for new apps would be nice-to-have, SAML required. SCIM: full lifecycle + group membership + a couple custom attrs (employeeType, costCenter). Domain verification: they need multiple domains verified and an enforcement policy so only users from verified domains can sign up.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Notes I can share:
- SAML: support HTTP-POST/Redirect, signed assertions supported, optional encrypted assertions (AES-256). Provide IdP metadata XML to configure.
- OIDC: we support standard OIDC flows (auth code + PKCE).
- SCIM: v2.0 with PATCH and delta tokens. Example PATCH to add group member:
```PATCH /scim/v2/Groups/{id}
Content-Type: application/json
[ { "op":"add", "path":"members", "value":[{"value":"user-123"}] } ]
```
- Rate limits: hosted default 60 rpm, Dedicated configurable.
Omar (Solutions Eng): For domain enforcement we support verified-domain policies. Example tenant config: `verified_domains: ["tidegate.com","eu.tidegate.com"]` and `signup_policy: verified_only`.
Jules (Pricing): Ballpark committed pricing options (for planning): small Dedicated (2x GPU equiv) ~ $10k/mo, medium (4x) ~ $20k/mo, large (8x) ~$38k/mo. BYOK + extended log retention + EU-only region are add-ons. Will draft 3 scenarios (trial -> mid commit -> enterprise) once we get throughput numbers.
Priya (Security): I'll assemble a one-page compliance summary + attachments (SOC2 cover, pen-test summary, BYOK steps). If they need field redaction for SCIM logs we can enable at ingestion. For EU residency + BYOK recommended: Dedicated in EU region or Private deployment (timeline ~6-8 weeks).
integration-bot: POC workspace created: https://console.redwood.example/tenancy/poc-tidegate (id: poc-tide-202407). Invite sent to poc@tidegate.com
Nina (AE): Timeline: kickoff next Wed, 10-business-day POC, decision window 21 days. Legal wants answers to questionnaire Q4-Q9 by Fri EOD. Owners: Omar = SE, Jules = pricing, Priya = security.
Omar (Solutions Eng): I'll prep the technical appendix (SAML metadata template, SCIM mappings, domain enforcement examples) and drop in shared drive. Need their Okta metadata + sample CSV of users with groups.
Jules (Pricing): I'll prepare the three committed scenarios and include EU-region pricing & BYOK add-ons.
Priya (Security): Uploading compliance pack now and will include a short mitigation plan per blocker.
Nina (AE): Thanks team. I'll request Okta metadata + CSV and confirm timeline with TideGate.
(threads end)
